products.title: 2025 Anniversary Series - 53.5% vol. 70cl
products.body_html:
2025 Anniversary Single Cask Release - Our first 12-Year-Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky. 

This remarkable whisky marks a true milestone in Wolfburn’s journey – our first ever 12-year-old single malt, a decade and more in the making.

As the third release in our celebrated Anniversary Series, it comes from Cask No.163 / 2013—one of the finest Oloroso sherry butts we’ve ever laid our hands on. Back in early 2013, a precious delivery of Spanish oak arrived at our distillery. Amongst them was a cask that when sampled through the years showed great promise and was left alone to let nature do its work.

Twelve years on that patience and foresight has matured this cask into something worthy of being our first 12-year-old release. The whisky drawn from Cask 163 is sweet, refined, and beautifully complex – a spirit that captures the very essence of the Wolfburn in every sip. More than just a dram, it’s a tribute to craftsmanship, patience, and the quiet mastery of traditional distilling. Bottled at a robust cask strength of 53.5% ABV, this limited-release of just 749 bottles is a tribute to the passage of time.

Tasting notes

ON THE NOSE – Strong sherry aromas meld perfectly with Wolfburn’s signature sweet floral notes. An exciting glimpse of things to come.  

ON THE PALATE – A panoply of flavours bursts onto the tastebuds. Oak and vanillin are immediately present, accompanied by sherry sweetness and hints of dark treacle. Wait a moment – give it time to truly reveal its depth. You’ll find honey, butterscotch, burnt orange and more, all in glorious harmony.  Truly this is a delicious dram, testament to the skill of Wolfburn’s master distillers. 

FINISH – We finish where we started, with wonderful sweet sherry notes making for a beautifully long, lingering finish.

Non chill-filtered / Natural Colour 
53.5% ABV.
70cl

products.title: 2026 Anniversary Series (Single bottle)
products.body_html:
Wolfburn 12-Year-Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky 

Released annually on Burns Night, Wolfburn’s Anniversary Single Cask bottling marks the moment spirit first flowed once again at the distillery on 25 January 2013. The 2026 edition celebrates 13 years since Wolfburn’s return to spirit and represents the fourth release in this highly sought-after series.

After extensive sampling, cask No. 811, filled in December 2013, was personally selected by our Production Manager as the cask that best captures the distillery’s character. Matured quietly in Warehouse No. 1 for twelve years, this single cask whisky was bottled at natural cask strength, yielding just 874 bottles at 55.2% ABV. 

This Wolfburn 12-year-old single malt sits confidently alongside previous Anniversary releases. Familiar malty undertones form the backbone of the spirit, complemented by layers of rich, rounded flavour developed through long maturation. Dark in colour and full-bodied on the palate, it is a patient, assured dram that reflects both time and craft.

ON THE NOSE
Exceptional sweet tones are immediately noticeable – golden syrup on toast, with a healthy addition of soft oak.

ON THE PALATE
The depth of flavour is such that this behaves more like a PX-matured whisky than Oloroso – a heady, creamy mouthful, truly decadent. The sweetness and depth of flavour is an absolute joy. Dates and raisins mingle with golden syrup and treacle, while Wolfburn’s signature soft floral notes overlay the whole.

FINISH
The end is just as sweet and luxurious as the beginning. A truly excellent dram in all respects. 

Non chill-filtered / Natural Colour
55.2% ABV.
70cl

Tasting notes

10-Year-Old

This 10-Year-Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky marks a significant milestone in the history of the distillery: it is our first permanent age-statement release. Crafted from spirit fully matured in hand-selected second-fill Oloroso sherry casks, a full decade in Spanish sherry oak has resulted in a delightfully sweet and sumptuous whisky – a fitting testament to the skill, dedication and patience of Wolfburn’s master distillers.

Non chill-filtered  / Natural Colour 

5cl / 46% ABV.

 

NORTHLAND

The smooth and warming flavours present in Northland come from the unhurried way in which the spirit is made, and from the maturation, which takes place in American oak quarter casks. Matured and bottled on site, Northland represents the first chapter in the history of Wolfburn.

Non chill-filtered  / Natural Colour 

5cl / 46% ABV.

 

AURORA

A beautiful sherried whisky is made from spirit laid down in a combination of bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks. Benefitting from long fermentation and slow, gentle distillation, the spirit is laid down on site in our purpose-built warehouses. At the end of the maturation process, the casks are brought together to create an exceptionally smooth and perfectly balanced dram.

Non chill-filtered  / Natural Colour 

5cl / 46% ABV.

 

MORVEN

This lightly peated whisky is made from malted barley infused with smoke during the drying process. It’s a reflection of history – the original 19th Century distillery was largely fired by peat. Gentle distillation is followed by maturation in our purpose-built warehouses. The result is a beautifully smooth and rounded whisky.

Non chill-filtered  / Natural Colour 

5cl / 46% ABV.

 

LANGSKIP

A sweet, balanced and beautifully easy-drinking dram, Langskip’s strength is matched only by its smoothness. Matured entirely in first-fill bourbon casks, this whisky has a unique richness and an extraordinary depth of flavour. Bottled at 58% alcohol by volume, Langskip represents the very best of Wolfburn.

Non chill-filtered  / Natural Colour 

5cl / 58% ABV.

products.title: Cask Strength Single Malt Scotch Whisky (Case of 6)
products.body_html:
Jim Murray opens his tasting year once. This year, he opened it with our Cask Strength Whisky.

Seven years in hand-selected bourbon and oloroso casks. Bottled straight from the wood at 56.9% vol. What's in the bottle is exactly what came out — lightly peated, intensely flavourful, and entirely unmediated.

Jim Murray tasted roughly 4,200 whiskies for the 2026 Whisky Bible. He scored ours 95 out of 100. Called it "a masterpiece from the far north." Said it was "far too complex to decide over from a single tasting alone." The 95-plus tier is the top 1% of everything he tastes, placing this among the top ten whiskies in the world. Murray takes no payment from distilleries. Not from us, not from anyone. The score is independent. It is earned.

We're proud of it. We're not surprised by it.

Want the full story behind the score? We've written about what the Jim Murray award means, how the Whisky Bible works, and why a 95 from the far north of Scotland matters — read it on the blog.

Tasting notes

ON THE NOSE – Fresh bourbon aromas are softened by sweet sherry essence. Hints of toffee and caramel shine through.

ON THE PALATE – Chocolate truffles meet sticky toffee pudding and trifle sponge – and the whole mouthful is wonderfully overlaid with gentle hints of peat smoke. By any standards this is a rich and sumptuous dram, bursting with flavour.

FINISH – Caramel sweetness is present, accompanied by hints of toffee and demerara sugar. A trace of peat smoke remains until the very end, ensuring a beautiful lingering finish.

Non chill-filtered / Natural Colour
58.2% ABV. 
70cl

products.title: Cognac Cask Finished (Case of 6)
products.body_html:
Cognac Cask-Finished Single Malt Whisky.

Some casks tell a story – of craftsmanship, of patience, of time well spent. Back in mid-2024, we secured a small number of exquisite Cognac casks, crafted from the finest French Limousin oak, and entrusted them with something truly special. Now, after years of careful maturation, we are proud to unveil Wolfburn’s first-ever Cognac Cask Finish single malt.

Matured to perfection in first-fill bourbon casks since 2017, this exceptional whisky spent its final six months resting in hand-selected Cognac casks, absorbing their rich character. The result? A symphony of luxurious flavours – honeyed fruit, warming spice, and an indulgent depth of sweetness that lingers long after the final sip.

There are just 3,900 bottles in total. 

Tasting notes

ON THE NOSE – Hints of dried fruits mix with sweet brandy notes. This is followed by aromas of vanilla, with just a hint of coffee and dark chocolate.

ON THE PALATE – A symphony of luxurious flavours. Dried apricots and almonds are overlaid with vanilla, accompanied by subtle hints of warm spice. Wait a while, and barley sugar makes itself known, along with soft dark chocolate. Truly, this is a decadent dram.

FINISH – It’s oh-so-sweet, with vanilla and autumn fruits gently fading away, leaving just a trace of caramel and sea salt at the very end.

Non chill-filtered / Natural Colour 
46% ABV.
70cl

products.title: Kylver 15 – 53.6% vol. 70cl
products.body_html:
Inside Wolfburn’s many warehouses lies a growing collection of ever-ageing casks, each quietly developing its unique character. While most are left undisturbed to mature gracefully, exceptional moments call for something extraordinary. The latest release in our acclaimed Kylver Series is just that – a rare single malt Scotch whisky crafted from a unique combination of first-fill bourbon barrels and a first-fill Oloroso sherry hogshead. This limited-edition Highland single malt is not only a true collector’s whisky, but also an exceptional dram—rich, refined, and full of character. 

Tasting notes

ON THE NOSE – Sweet heather honey and light oak mix with dried fruit, and there’s a beautiful rich overtone of demerara sugar and molasses. 

ON THE PALATE – Heady stuff – this really is a sumptuous dram. Maple syrup leads the way, overlaid with creamy chocolate. Give it time and deeper, more subtle flavours reveal themselves: dried autumn fruits and soft spices are present, and later the palate reveals a rich butterscotch note.  

FINISH – Light oak flavours linger to the end, overlaid with floral honey tones. A truly exceptional dram, which in many ways is the perfect example of Wolfburn’s craft.

Non chill-filtered / Natural Colour 
53.6% ABV.
70cl

About the Kylver series

Launched in 2016, Wolfburn’s collectors’ series is named after the ancient Kylver Stone, which was unearthed near a Viking burial site in Sweden. The stone depicts the complete Viking runic alphabet, and each whisky takes its name from a runic letter. The Kylver series reflects the unique Viking heritage of Caithness – the entire area around the distillery was once populated by Vikings, and the town of Thurso is named after the god Thor.  

The whisky inside the bottles follows no particular pattern, aside from being of exceptionally good quality. Wolfburn’s master distillers spend a lot of their time sourcing the very best casks from around the world, be it from the bourbon houses of southern USA or the sherry bodegas of southern Spain, and sometimes further afield, such as the rum distilleries of the Caribbean. All casks are different of course, and we select the best of the best to create each Kylver bottling.

products.body_html:
Manzanilla Sherry Cask Finished Whisky, crafted from the finest Spanish oak these Manzanilla casks arrived at Wolfburn with an exquisitely dry nose to them. Used to finish this whisky at the end of its maturation the resultant dram is a delight. Fruity, sweet, full-bodied and sumptuous. A whisky that every whisky lover should try.

Tasting notes

ON THE NOSE – Golden syrup meets cashew nut butter, overlaid with seductive vinous tones. An exceptional depth of sweet aromas. 

ON THE PALATE – There’s a wonderful oily richness to this dram – it coats the palate and the flavours just keep unfurling. Classic dry Manzanilla tones lead to rich fruit flavours: sultanas, plums and dates, with subtle hints of toffee and honey. 

FINISH – Sweet wine and fruit flavours fade gently away, leaving a lingering hint of caramel.

products.body_html:
A Day of Tradition, Celebration & Whisky

As one of the proud main sponsors, we were honoured to stand alongside and support the annual event once again. The Games featured a vibrant array of traditional events, including the ever-popular tug o’ war, caber tossing, massed pipe bands, Highland dancing, track events, feats of strength, novelty races and the odd special guest – making it a true highlight of the Caithness calendar.

A few bottles from the day still remain – a rare chance to take home a piece of the Games.

Tasting notes

ON THE NOSE – On the nose, soft sherry sweetness melds with figs and raisins. There’s a lovely hint of vanilla and oak present too.

ON THE PALATE – The depth of flavour is tremendous. Bold chocolate and dark fruit flavours abound, with overtones of caramel and vanilla, all accompanied by gentle hints of nutmeg and oak smoke.

FINISH – Silky tannins make for a beautifully textured finish; there’s a residual sweetness with dried fruit and caramel flavours lingering to the very end.   

Non-chill filtered / Natural Colour

NORTHLAND

The smooth and warming flavours present in Northland come from the unhurried way in which the spirit is made, and from the maturation, which takes place in American oak quarter casks. Matured and bottled on site, Northland represents the first chapter in the history of Wolfburn.

 AURORA

A beautiful sherried whisky is made from spirit laid down in a combination of bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks. Benefitting from long fermentation and slow, gentle distillation, the spirit is laid down on site in our purpose-built warehouses. At the end of the maturation process the casks are brought together to create an exceptionally smooth and perfectly balanced dram.

Non chill-filtered  / Natural Colour 
5cl / 46% ABV.

 

MORVEN

This lightly peated whisky is made from malted barley infused with smoke during the drying process. It’s a reflection of history – the original 19th Century distillery was largely fired by peat. Gentle distillation is followed by maturation in our purpose-built warehouses. The result is a beautifully smooth and rounded whisky.

Non chill-filtered  / Natural Colour 
5cl / 46% ABV.

 

LANGSKIP

A sweet, balanced and beautifully easy-drinking dram, Langskip’s strength is matched only by its smoothness. Matured entirely in first-fill bourbon casks, this whisky has a unique richness and an extraordinary depth of flavour. Bottled at 58% alcohol by volume, Langskip represents the very best of Wolfburn.

products.title: Small Batch 416 Single Malt Scotch Whisky (Case of 6)
products.body_html:
Small Batch 416 Single Malt Scotch Whisky. 

Wolfburn Small Batch Release 416 is a 10-year-old single malt Scotch whisky bottled at 46% vol, fully matured in first-fill ruby port pipes sourced from a vineyard in Portugal's Douro Valley, one of the world's oldest protected wine regions. It is the first age-stated expression in the Wolfburn Small Batch Series. Just 3,900 bottles produced.

We sourced those port pipes in 2016. A small parcel from a vineyard deep in a region that has been producing wine longer than most countries have existed. We filled them, sealed them, and left them alone to do what time does best. What came back, ten years later, is a whisky with a depth of flavour that more than justifies the wait.

The Small Batch 416 release carries everything that makes Wolfburn distinctive: Caithness water, seaside warehouse maturation, copper pot stills, shaped over a decade by some of the finest ruby port casks we've worked with to date.

No chill filtration. No artificial colour. 46% vol. Ten years of maturation on Scotland's north coast, in casks sourced from one of the world's most celebrated wine regions.

3,900 bottles. No second run. If you're looking for a limited-edition port-cask single malt Scotch whisky that genuinely earns every word of its description, this is it.

If Release 416 is your introduction to aged Wolfburn, it won't be your last. Our 12 Year Old Single Malt, the flagship of the Wolfburn range, matured in equal parts Oloroso sherry butts and ex-bourbon casks, offers a different window into what time and good wood can do to Caithness spirit. A permanent home for those who want to explore further. And if you'd like to see where the Small Batch Series has been before it gets here, the full archive of previous releases tells the story.

ON THE NOSE 
Warm ruby port aromas drift alongside a delicate whisper of sea salt. Dried fruits slowly emerge – raisins, dark cherries and sultanas, in a deeply vinous embrace that hints at the extraordinary casks at work.

ON THE PALATE
Luscious caramel and smooth vanilla arrive first, underpinned by beautiful wine-soaked flavours. Darker notes follow, gentle oak smoke and the rich sweetness of dates and figs with a supple, full-bodied texture and outstanding depth of flavour.

FINISH
Long and warming. Caramel and dried fruits linger with quiet confidence, while those signature ruby port notes weave through to the very end. 

Non chill-filtered / Natural Colour 
46% ABV.
70cl
